name: Iinari Tsumairo ~Tomaranai Koshizukai~
original_name: イイナリ妻色 ～止まらない腰使い～
source:
Unforeseen events occur in a housewife's life, the seduction of lonely women and relationships between couples, etc.A variety of events occurring in different women's lives is depicted.

All of the heroines are enjoying their lives.
But, each one has a hidden secret.
The main character discovers their secrets and manipulates them to be obedient to him.
They project a life of happiness in public, but actually reveal their humiliation and erotic pleasure in private with you.
You are the only one who will know!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139630/Obedient_Women/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
家庭主妇的生活中发生的意外事件、孤独女性的诱惑、夫妻关系等。描绘了不同女性生活中发生的各种事件。

所有的女主角都过着幸福的生活。
但是，每个人都有一个隐藏的秘密。
主角发现了他们的秘密并操纵他们服从他。
他们在公共场合表现出幸福的生活，但实际上却在私下与你流露出他们的屈辱和性快感。
你是唯一知道的人！
